records.source: Finally... some heavy rain. I get bored of sunny weather easily.
records.translation: Sa wakas... malakas na ulan. Madali akong magsawa sa maaraw na panahon.

records.source: Hey. I was just thinking about my old room in the basement. I felt comfortable there, but this is a lot more interesting. And I don't miss the smell...#$e#I felt kind of embarrassed living in my mom's house for so long.
records.translation: Uy. Iniisip ko lang ang dati kong kuwarto sa silong. Komportable ako roon, pero mas interesante rito. At hindi ko nami-miss ang amoy...#$e#Medyo nakakahiya na nanirahan ako nang napakatagal sa bahay ni Nanay.

records.source: Hey. I couldn't sleep last night so I took a walk to the caves. I found this... want it?[575 769 767 84 66 78]#$e#I just have trouble sleeping sometimes, it has nothing to do with you. I love you.$7
records.translation: Uy. Hindi ako nakatulog kagabi kaya naglakad ako papunta sa mga yungib. Natagpuan ko ito... gusto mo?[575 769 767 84 66 78]#$e#Nahihirapan lang talaga akong matulog minsan, wala itong kinalaman sa iyo. Mahal kita.$7

records.source: Seems like a pretty good day to just lay around, maybe read a book or something... what do you think?
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw para humiga lang, baka magbasa ng aklat o anuman... ano sa tingin mo?

records.source: Hey, another rainy day... perfect.#$e#You look cold... here, come closer.$l
records.translation: Uy, isa na namang maulang araw... perpekto.#$e#Mukhang nilalamig ka... halika, lumapit ka.$l

records.source: I'm trying my best to quit smoking now that we're married... I don't wanna die on you. It's a bad habit.#$e#I want to have a future together.$l
records.translation: Ginagawa ko ang lahat para tumigil sa paninigarilyo ngayong kasal na tayo... Ayaw kong mamatay at iwan ka. Masamang bisyo ito.#$e#Gusto kong magkaroon tayo ng hinaharap.$l

records.source: Need something? I'll just be over here working on my bike for a while.
records.translation: May kailangan ka? Narito lang ako at kakalikotin ang motorsiklo ko sandali.

records.source: I did some work on the laptop today. I was actually brainstorming some ideas for a game I want to make.#$e#With your farming income, I can afford to do what I want with my life. It's pretty amazing. Thank you.$h
records.translation: May ginawa akong trabaho sa laptop ngayon. Sa totoo lang, nag-iisip ako ng mga ideya para sa larong gusto kong gawin.#$e#Dahil sa kita mo sa pagsasaka, kaya kong gawin ang gusto ko sa buhay. Talagang kahanga-hanga iyon. Salamat.$h

records.source: Sorry, I didn't make any dinner. We might have a frozen pizza in the fridge or something.#$e#I dunno, my mind was elsewhere. It's hard to remember to do chores...
records.translation: Pasensiya na, wala akong inihandang hapunan. Baka may nakapirming pizza tayo sa pridyider o anuman.#$e#Hindi ko alam, kung saan-saan lumilipad ang isip ko. Mahirap tandaang gawin ang mga gawain...

records.source: How was your day? Did you slay any monsters?$h#$e#It feels good to take out your aggression now and then, doesn't it?
records.translation: Kumusta ang araw mo? May pinaslang ka bang halimaw?$h#$e#Masarap ilabas ang galit paminsan-minsan, hindi ba?

records.source: Maybe a witch will visit us tonight? Hah.. if only life was that interesting...
records.translation: Baka dalawin tayo ng isang mangkukulam ngayong gabi? Hah... kung ganoon lang sana kainteresante ang buhay...

records.source: The older I get, the less I'm drawn to the city. It had a certain mystique to it, once. But it turns out that was just a romantic fantasy.#$e#The city's so busy, so full of people... I don't belong there. I'm a loner.
records.translation: Habang tumatanda ako, lalo akong nawawalan ng interes sa lungsod. May kakaiba itong hiwaga noon. Pero isa lang pala iyong romantikong pantasya.#$e#Napakaabala ng lungsod at napakaraming tao... Hindi ako nababagay roon. Mapag-isa ako.

records.source: Hey... want some coffee?[395]$7#$e#I needed some... woke up early from a nightmare and I just couldn't fall back asleep.
records.translation: Uy... gusto mo ng kape?[395]$7#$e#Kailangan ko nito... Maaga akong nagising dahil sa bangungot at hindi na ako nakatulog ulit.

records.source: I couldn't sleep last night so I went for a night ride on the motorcycle.#$e#I need to stay independent, even though we're married. That's just how I am. I still love you, though.$7
records.translation: Hindi ako makatulog kagabi kaya namasyal ako sakay ng motorsiklo.#$e#Kailangan kong manatiling malaya kahit kasal na tayo. Ganoon lang talaga ako. Pero mahal pa rin kita.$7

records.source: Hey. How'd you sleep last night? I heard you mumbling.#$e#You seemed scared, but I have to admit... it was kind of cute.$l
records.translation: Uy. Kumusta ang tulog mo kagabi? Narinig kitang bumubulong.#$e#Mukha kang natatakot, pero aaminin ko... medyo kaibig-ibig iyon.$l

records.source: Living here with you is teaching me to come out of my shell a little bit. I think it's good for me.$7
records.translation: Tinuturuan ako ng pagtira rito kasama mo na lumabas nang kaunti sa sarili kong mundo. Sa tingin ko ay mabuti iyon para sa akin.$7

records.source: Hey. I just hung out around the house, today. Nothing interesting...#$e#...#$e#The view from our house is perfect. You can see the sun setting over Pelican Town from the front porch.
records.translation: Uy. Tumambay lang ako sa bahay ngayon. Walang interesante...#$e#...#$e#Perpekto ang tanawin mula sa bahay natin. Makikita mula sa balkonahe sa harap ang paglubog ng araw sa Bayan ng Pelican.

records.source: Maybe I drank too much coffee... I don't feel very tired.#$e#I'm still trying to adjust to the farm schedule. I used to stay up until 5am and sleep in until 2pm, sometimes.$h
records.translation: Baka naparami ang kape ko... Hindi ako gaanong inaantok.#$e#Sinisikap ko pa ring masanay sa iskedyul sa bukid. Dati ay gising ako hanggang alas-singko ng umaga at natutulog hanggang alas-dos ng hapon kung minsan.$h

records.source: It's really cool to have our own place. I can do whatever I feel like and not have people nagging at me all the time.#$e#I'm sure Maru's happy that I'm gone.
records.translation: Ang astig na mayroon tayong sariling lugar. Magagawa ko ang anumang gusto ko nang walang taong laging kumukulit sa akin.#$e#Tiyak akong masaya si Maru na wala na ako.

records.source: I spotted a bat out the window earlier. It's kind of hard to see, but if you stay focused you can often catch them flittering about. They're out there.
records.translation: May nakita akong paniki sa labas ng bintana kanina. Medyo mahirap silang makita, pero kung magtutuon ka ng pansin ay madalas mo silang makikitang palipad-lipad. Naroon sila.

records.source: I often felt unappreciated back home... but here I feel like I really belong. Thanks for making me feel welcome, @.$l
records.translation: Madalas kong maramdamang hindi ako pinahahalagahan sa dati kong tahanan... pero pakiramdam ko ay talagang may lugar ako rito. Salamat sa pagtanggap sa akin, @.$l

records.source: I feel like I want to do something today... but I'm not sure what. Do you ever have that problem, @?
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay may gusto akong gawin ngayon... pero hindi ko alam kung ano. Nagkakaganiyan ka rin ba, @?

records.source: Hmm... sometimes I have to force myself to stay outside for health.#$e#I dunno what it is, but I like being indoors. Maybe I'm just so used to my dark basement.
records.translation: Hmm... minsan ay kailangan kong pilitin ang sarili kong manatili sa labas para sa kalusugan.#$e#Hindi ko alam kung bakit, pero gusto kong nasa loob. Baka sanay na sanay lang ako sa madilim kong silong.

records.source: I'll just watch you from here.$h#$e#I enjoy watching you.
records.translation: Panoorin lang kita mula rito.$h#$e#Nasisiyahan akong panoorin ka.

records.source: I don't want to get soft now that I'm a married guy. Maybe I should start eating more hot pepper and working out?#$e#Just an idea...$h
records.translation: Ayaw kong lumambot ngayong may asawa na ako. Baka dapat akong kumain ng mas maraming maanghang na sili at mag-ehersisyo?#$e#Ideya lang...$h

records.source: We should raise more slimes... In big quantities they can be pretty profitable. And they're so easy to raise.#$e#Also, different colored slimes produce different items. I dunno, I think it'd be kind of a fun hobby for us.
records.translation: Dapat tayong mag-alaga ng mas maraming Slime... Malaki ang kikitain sa mga iyon kapag marami. At napakadali nilang alagaan.#$e#Isa pa, iba’t ibang bagay ang nililikha ng iba’t ibang kulay ng Slime. Hindi ko alam, parang masayang libangan iyon para sa atin.

records.source: I'm still getting used to being a father. Don't worry, I'll take good care of %kid1! It's just... something new.
records.translation: Nanininibago pa rin ako sa pagiging ama. Huwag kang mag-alala, aalagaan kong mabuti si %kid1! Bago lang talaga ito.

records.source: Maybe when %kid1 is a little older, I'll get a sidecar for the bike and we can all go for a ride.$h
records.translation: Baka kapag medyo mas matanda na si %kid1, lalagyan ko ng sidecar ang motorsiklo at makapamamasyal tayong lahat.$h

records.source: Have you smelled %kid1? Maybe it's time for a bath...
records.translation: Naamoy mo na ba si %kid1? Baka oras na para paliguan siya...

records.source: Don't worry, I already fed the kids... %kid2 spilled the chocolate milk all over my shirt again.
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala, napakain ko na ang mga bata... Natapon na naman ni %kid2 ang gatas na tsokolate sa buong damit ko.

records.source: I hope %kid1 and %kid2 are nice to each other. Maru and I always fought as kids.#$e#If I think back on it, it was mostly my fault...
records.translation: Sana ay mabait sa isa’t isa sina %kid1 at %kid2. Lagi kaming nag-aaway ni Maru noong bata pa kami.#$e#Kung iisipin ko iyon, kadalasan ay kasalanan ko pala...

records.source: I've had this recurring dream that %kid2 is wearing a shadow shaman costume and sitting on a glowing pumpkin. Weird, huh?
records.translation: Paulit-ulit kong napapanaginipang nakasuot si %kid2 ng kasuotang Salamangkero ng Anino at nakaupo sa kumikinang na kalabasa. Kakaiba, ano?

records.source: We've come a long way, @. Look at our family. To be honest, I never really thought I'd end up in this situation.#$e#Now that I'm here, I like it...$l
records.translation: Napakalayo na ng narating natin, @. Tingnan mo ang pamilya natin. Sa totoo lang, hindi ko inakalang mapupunta ako sa ganitong kalagayan.#$e#Ngayong narito na ako, gusto ko ito...$l

records.source: Hey. Look at me. Never forget that I love you... you're everything to me.$l#$b#Now go make us some money.$h
records.translation: Uy. Tingnan mo ako. Huwag mong kalilimutan na mahal kita... ikaw ang lahat sa akin.$l#$b#Ngayon, kumita ka na ng pera para sa atin.$h

records.source: Hey... come here. You look great today.$l
records.translation: Uy... halika rito. Ang ganda ng hitsura mo ngayon.$l

records.source: You always look great, even after slopping around in the yard all day.$l
records.translation: Lagi kang maganda, kahit matapos kang magpakalublob sa putik sa bakuran buong araw.$l

records.source: I don't often show it, but I'm really happy that I'm your husband. Marrying you was the best decision I ever made.$l
records.translation: Hindi ko ito madalas ipakita, pero napakasaya kong asawa mo ako. Ang pagpapakasal sa iyo ang pinakamagandang pasiyang ginawa ko.$l

records.source: You don't ever have to worry about me. I like to spend a lot of time alone.
records.translation: Hindi mo kailangang mag-alala sa akin kailanman. Gusto kong maglaan ng maraming oras nang mag-isa.

records.source: Sometimes I feel so angry... but when you show up I always start to calm down.$7#$e#Maybe I'll mellow out with age.
records.translation: Minsan ay galit na galit ako... pero kapag dumarating ka, lagi akong nagsisimulang kumalma.$7#$e#Baka maging mas mahinahon ako habang tumatanda.

records.source: I know you're tough, but I still worry about you, sometimes. Don't ever go monster hunting without a life elixir and some sturdy boots, okay?
records.translation: Alam kong matatag ka, pero nag-aalala pa rin ako sa iyo minsan. Huwag kang mangaso ng halimaw nang walang Eliksir ng Buhay at matibay na bota, ha?

records.source: I don't really feel like doing work today. Maybe I'll see what's on TV.
records.translation: Wala talaga akong ganang magtrabaho ngayon. Baka tingnan ko kung ano ang nasa telebisyon.

records.source: I don't really need friends. You're the only person I need in my life. Is that weird?#$e#I guess I'm not like most people.
records.translation: Hindi ko talaga kailangan ng mga kaibigan. Ikaw lang ang kailangan ko sa buhay. Kakaiba ba iyon?#$e#Siguro ay hindi ako katulad ng karamihan.

records.source: When I take walks I do my best to avoid everyone. I hate being pressured into small talk.
records.translation: Kapag naglalakad ako, ginagawa ko ang lahat upang maiwasan ang lahat. Ayaw kong pinipilit sa mababaw na kuwentuhan.

records.source: Why don't you tell me about your day when we're in bed tonight? I'm kind of busy right now...
records.translation: Bakit hindi mo ikuwento sa akin ang araw mo kapag nasa kama na tayo mamayang gabi? Medyo abala ako ngayon...

records.source: Are you going into town today? Why, what are you up to?
records.translation: Pupunta ka ba sa bayan ngayon? Bakit, ano ang gagawin mo?

records.source: I guess I can do the laundry today... You probably have your hands full with running the farm.
records.translation: Siguro ay makakapaglaba ako ngayon... Malamang ay marami kang inaasikaso sa pagpapatakbo ng bukid.

records.source: Are we doing okay on money? I don't want to have to sell my laptop...
records.translation: Ayos ba tayo sa pera? Ayaw kong ibenta ang laptop ko...

records.source: If you need to go see your friends in town, go ahead. I like being alone, anyways.
records.translation: Kung kailangan mong puntahan ang mga kaibigan mo sa bayan, sige lang. Gusto ko namang mapag-isa.

records.source: House-cleaning isn't fun, but when I listen to music, it goes by pretty fast.
records.translation: Hindi nakakatuwa ang paglilinis ng bahay, pero mabilis itong natatapos kapag nakikinig ako ng musika.

records.source: Look, I just want to be alone. Why don't you go outside and do your own thing for a while?
records.translation: Makinig ka, gusto ko lang mapag-isa. Bakit hindi ka lumabas at gawin muna ang gusto mo?

records.source: What do you want? You sound like my step-dad. Go away.$a
records.translation: Ano ang gusto mo? Para kang amain ko. Umalis ka.$a

records.source: This place is starting to feel like a tomb.$s
records.translation: Nagsisimula nang maging parang libingan ang lugar na ito.$s

records.source: I started smoking again... I've just been really stressed out lately.$s
records.translation: Nagsimula ulit akong manigarilyo... Talagang matindi ang tensiyon ko nitong huli.$s

records.source: I'm going to take a walk today. I need some time to myself. I'll see you in the evening.
records.translation: Maglalakad ako ngayon. Kailangan ko ng oras para sa sarili ko. Magkita tayo mamayang gabi.

records.source: My day was fine, nothing much to tell you about. Why don't you tell me about yours?
records.translation: Ayos lang ang araw ko, walang gaanong maikukuwento. Bakit hindi mo naman ikuwento ang araw mo?

records.source: Oohh... my head. Happy new year...$h
records.translation: Oohh... ang ulo ko. Maligayang bagong taon...$h

records.source: Are you excited for tomorrow's festival? It'll be good to see Sam again.
records.translation: Nasasabik ka ba sa pista bukas? Masarap makita ulit si Sam.

records.source: Oh... tomorrow's the flower dance, isn't it? Do we have to go?#$e#I hate wearing that ridiculous tight jumpsuit. Why does Lewis make us do this?$s
records.translation: Ah... Sayaw ng Bulaklak bukas, hindi ba? Kailangan ba nating pumunta?#$e#Ayaw kong suotin ang katawa-tawang masikip na kasuotang iyon. Bakit tayo pinipilit ni Lewis na gawin ito?$s

records.source: Summer's here... I need to start slathering the sunscreen pretty thick if I want to maintain my pale complexion...
records.translation: Narito na ang tag-init... Kailangan kong maglagay ng maraming kremang panangga sa araw kung gusto kong mapanatili ang maputla kong kutis...

records.source: Have you thought about what you're going to put in the luau soup?#$e#I have no idea what's good... you're the chef!$7
records.translation: Naisip mo na ba kung ano ang ilalagay mo sa sopas ng Luau?#$e#Wala akong alam kung ano ang masarap... ikaw ang mahusay magluto!$7

records.source: The weather's starting to cool off. It feels great.#$e#Should we go to the festival tomorrow night? It's actually a tradition I kind of enjoy.$7
records.translation: Nagsisimula nang lumamig ang panahon. Napakasarap sa pakiramdam.#$e#Pupunta ba tayo sa pista bukas ng gabi? Sa totoo lang, medyo gusto ko ang tradisyong iyon.$7

records.source: It seems like the whole valley's changed overnight... I guess fall's finally here.
records.translation: Parang nagbago ang buong lambak sa magdamag... Mukhang dumating na nga ang taglagas.

records.source: The Stardew Valley Fair is a little crowded for my tastes... but I'll just hang out with Sam. It'll be good to catch up with him.#$e#You should play some carnival games, though! Don't worry about me.$7
records.translation: Medyo masyadong matao para sa akin ang Perya ng Stardew Valley... pero tatambay na lang ako kasama si Sam. Masarap makipagkuwentuhan ulit sa kaniya.#$e#Pero dapat mong subukan ang ilang larong perya! Huwag kang mag-alala sa akin.$7

records.source: I'm excited for the Spirit's Eve tomorrow. I wonder what horrors we'll find there.$h
records.translation: Nasasabik ako sa Bisperas ng mga Espiritu bukas. Iniisip ko kung anong mga kakila-kilabot na bagay ang matatagpuan natin doon.$h

records.source: What are your plans this winter? I know it's more of a laid-back time for you.
records.translation: Ano ang mga plano mo ngayong taglamig? Alam kong mas maluwag ang iskedyul mo sa panahong ito.

records.source: Are you going to enter the fishing contest tomorrow?
records.translation: Sasali ka ba sa paligsahan sa pangingisda bukas?

records.source: It's been a great year, @. We should celebrate a little. [346]$h#$e#I'm sure next year will be even better.$7
records.translation: Napakaganda ng taong ito, @. Dapat tayong magdiwang nang kaunti. [346]$h#$e#Tiyak akong mas maganda pa ang susunod na taon.$7
